quotes.text: Customize the default splash screen for your readers.

old_evidence.text: Locations without a custom splash screen inherit the account default splash screen.
You can’t upload or apply a single splash screen across every reader type.
the splash screen updates when it’s connected to the Stripe Terminal SDK.

findings: November is a variant index for Dashboard and API paths. The 2026-05-01 combined capture remains the substantive source for ready-to-pay display, account default and location override, and per-reader-type configuration.

Dashboard operators choose or create a configuration, select a reader model, upload a conforming image and apply the change. API integrators upload with a dedicated file purpose and supply the file ID to the matching device configuration.

The existing source accurately retains the major hierarchy, resolution, supported types and timing. It can restore the May WisePad 3 slight repositioning and iterative GIF frame reduction when discussing image behavior.

The standalone 2026-11-07 raw provides two .md variant routes in place of the retained page body. This is a navigation change. Its omission of requirements and examples does not establish any workflow or device-support change.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep the 2026-05-01 full capture and its account default, location override and inheritance, reader-type selection, file-size, exact dimension, WisePad 3 conversion, automatic GIF scaling and under-limit GIF troubleshooting qualifications.
Preserve the SDK-connection trigger for mobile readers versus up to ten minutes for smart-reader splash changes, and the dedicated file purpose plus create/update Configuration flow.
Keep exact models and device keys. The May list identifies Verifone P400 specifically. Other Verifone models need separate authority.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/splash-screen, source-stripe-terminal-splash-screen should link the independent 2026-11-07 Dashboard/API index. The index gives the topic and routes without documenting actors, implementation prerequisites or state changes (new raw lines 5-14). The full 2026-05-01 guide describes the ready-to-accept-payments screen. A location-specific value overrides the account default and a location without one inherits it (old raw lines 8-13). Dashboard operators select the location and exact reader type, upload a conforming image, save and apply. A single image cannot be applied across all types. Mobile readers update on SDK connection and smart readers within ten minutes (old raw lines 19-41 and old raw lines 43-55). API integrators first upload through the Files API using terminal_reader_splashscreen, then create or update a Configuration with splashscreen set to the file ID for the selected supported device type. Stripe provisions the account default (old raw lines 61-70 and old raw lines 87-113 and old raw lines 118-133). The mapped summary reflects most of this May evidence. Retain WisePad 3 PNG-only conversion and repositioning, exact per-model requirements and GIF upload caveat (old raw lines 43-53).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/splash-screen, use the 2026-11-07 capture as navigation for source-stripe-terminal-splash-screen. It lists the Dashboard and API .md variants (new raw lines 9-14), corresponding to the earlier combined capture's embedded routes (old raw lines 15-19 and old raw lines 57-64). The omitted May body remains the dated behavioral authority. Preserve per-model resolution, JPG/PNG below 2 MB with exact cropping, GIF below 4 MB with automatic scaling where supported, the possible need to repeatedly reduce frames, and WisePad 3 PNG-only black-and-white conversion and repositioning (old raw lines 25-27 and old raw lines 43-55). Preserve the mobile SDK connection trigger and smart-reader ten-minute timing in the splash-specific route; the generic configuration timing is a separate scope (old raw line 55). Keep the Configuration API's file purpose and exact device keys, including Verifone P400, without generalizing to all Verifone models (old raw lines 87-102). The phrase ‘change the passcode’ is a location-selection wording error. The next steps choose the splash screen and reader type, and the alternate route does the same without changing a passcode. See old raw lines 21-29 and old raw lines 31-41. The pinned summary only links the May 1, 2026 behavioral raw (summary lines 33–36). Retain that link and append the November 7, 2026 navigation raw as a separate entry. Retain the concept-to-source link already present at wiki/concepts/stripe-terminal-hardware-orders.md:128 and add a source-to-stripe-terminal-hardware-orders link to complete the reciprocal route. Keep the existing parent stripe-terminal fleet/reader route and the provider index and company routes.
